blocks.title: About us
blocks.body:
Test Clothing / garments is a clothing / garments in Rewari since 2015. We offer men's, women's & kids' wear, ethnic & wedding wear, alteration & fitting, school & office uniforms. We give every customer our full time and tell the price before we start.

Latest designs, every season, Sizes for everyone, Trial room and honest advice — that is how we work. How it goes: Browse or ask → Try it on → Fitting if needed → Wear it happily. Message us on WhatsApp and we reply quickly — for Rewari and nearby.

items.q: Do you have a trial room?
items.a: Yes, try before you buy; our staff helps you find the right size.

items.q: Can I exchange if the size is wrong?
items.a: Yes, with the bill and tags intact, within the exchange period we tell you at billing.
Yes, length and fitting are adjusted here; ask at billing when it will be ready.

items.q: Do you take bulk or uniform orders?
items.a: Yes, for schools, offices and events. Message us the sizes and quantity for a quote.

items.q: Can I see new arrivals on WhatsApp?
items.a: Yes, message us what you are looking for and we send photos and sizes.
Cash, UPI and cards at the showroom; UPI for reserved pieces on WhatsApp.
